history.reason: The request says only that after h_re, h_rdata must show the addressed register "within 2 clocks". Bench B samples after one edge past the capture edge and failed on an X value, so it demands the data earlier than the allowed window, while bench A waits the full allowance and passes. Where the request is ambiguous, the verdict goes to bench_wrong.

The request says the host holds rst for a few clocks and that h_rdata must show the addressed register within 2 clocks of h_re, and bench B did exactly that (rst for 5 clocks, 3 idle clocks, then a ROM read) but got an all-X h_rdata. Bench A waits 20 clocks after reset before any access, so it never exercises the early window; the request does not allow a design to need a longer settling time.
